name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Monthly limits per category. Pip suggests them from last month's spending, shows a bar for each category in Insights, tells you what's left when you add an expense, and lets you know at 50%, 75% and 90% after Apple Pay purchases.
